future_check: Keep all_five_transform_outputs_distinct at 100% and lesson_identifiable at 100% after template or scheduling changes.
rationale: A symmetric crop lets command-blind or fixed-transform rules fit demonstrations. Seven exhaustively checked asymmetric templates plus a command cycle make the intended command map identifiable while retaining canonical 3x3 anchors.
summary: Every ordinary generated motif distinguishes all five commanded outputs, and every five-demo lesson exposes all five command mappings.

future_check: Preserve the enclosed-island positive fixture and outside-bbox negative fixture.
rationale: The held-out canonical pair has a disconnected colored island inside the selected bbox and includes it in the correct output. An outside-bbox recombination remains oracle-executable but is structurally rejected.
summary: The lawful crop retains all colored cells inside the selected component bounding box; it is not limited to one connected component.

future_check: Require positive command_colour_reused_in_motif and command_colour_absent_from_motif witnesses in every band.
rationale: The original generator always excluded the command color, but canonical examples include both overlap and absence. A boolean command_in_motif axis now positively covers both without changing the rule.
summary: The command color is not required to be absent from the motif.

future_check: Apply the Racket/canonical patch atomically with the generator hash change and reject future source-sync patches that strip comments.
rationale: The baseline divergence was comment-only and execution-equivalent. The isolated proposal made canonical program_solution, task-local raw_code, and target_code exact matches while preserving semantic comments and solving all canonical pairs.
summary: Synchronize by promoting the richer commented rule to canonical and repinning RULE_HASH; never delete comments.

future_check: Intake should add the preserved comments to canonical or teach source-sync gates to represent comment-only active divergence as nonblocking.
rationale: Deleting the three task-local comments would violate the packet contract and degrade training text. Comment-stripped normalization and execution parity both pass, but exact active-source sync still fails because canonical omits comments.
summary: Task-local raw_code now matches the richer commented target_code; canonical remains comment-stripped by policy.

future_check: After any AXES edit, require the v6 exact override matrix and ordinary keyed-axis comparison to report zero mismatches.
rationale: The assigned generator accepted four metadata axes without consuming or exposing them. The repair replaces diagnostic aliases with grid dimensions, command, motif profile, motif color count, and command-color overlap, and supplies observe_overrides for exact recovery.
summary: All six declared axes are exact, recoverable from the returned grid, and supported across their full Cartesian boundary matrix.

future_check: New witnesses must declare at least one rival and pass the strict claim-holds audit with zero violations.
rationale: Four morphology witnesses were only presence checks. Because every generated motif has five distinct transform outputs, the shifted command-map rival disagrees with the oracle whenever those witnesses fire.
summary: Every semantic witness now names a rival that it demonstrably falsifies.

future_check: Expand only after exhaustive five-transform distinctness, 200-per-band main/stability censuses, and 60-lesson rival checks all pass.
rationale: The finite bank guarantees all five command outputs are distinct and prevents command-blind lessons, but it does not represent every possible polyomino topology.
summary: Morphology is deliberately bounded to seven audited asymmetric templates.

future_check: Only expand the template family with an exhaustive five-transform distinctness test and a fresh 200-per-band semantic/stability census.
rationale: The finite family guarantees five-way transform distinguishability and exact observability. Palettes, positions, dimensions, command overlap, and command mappings still vary broadly, but unseen motif topologies are outside this candidate's declared grammar.
summary: Motif morphology is deliberately bounded to seven audited templates rather than sampled from every possible connected polyomino.

future_check: Any predicate edit must retain 5/5 canonical acceptance and rerun both 200-per-band main and disjoint stability ranges.
rationale: The baseline census could not discover the existing strict hook. Adding only the adapter converted the exact same 200-per-band main/stability protocol from exit 1 to count-backed success without changing generator behavior.
summary: Keep the diagnostic strict_canonical_like hook and expose a boolean canonical_like adapter for the pinned uniform census.
